elements.text: It strips the wax. Your paint loses its protection.
Dirty bristles drag grit across the paint. Hello, swirl marks.
Brake dust from the wheels ends up scratching the paint.
Soap dries before you rinse. The water spots stay.
It's acidic. Leave it and it can etch the clear coat.

children.text: Five car crimes. Be honest. You're guilty.
Dish soap on your paint? That strips the wax right off.
The brush car wash? Hello, swirl marks.
Same towel for wheels and paint? That's brake dust. Basically sandpaper.
Washing in the hot sun? Soap dries, spots stay.
Bird mess sitting for a week? That eats into your clear coat.
